subsystem: Data Layout Optimization (FlatArray 2.0, Polymorphic Field IC, Typed Local Cache)

flat_array_contracts.boxing_claim: Zero VMValue boxing/unboxing on homogeneous flat-buffer access
flat_array_contracts.representation_lock: Locked representation guards against illegal heterogeneous mutation under JIT specialization
flat_array_contracts.small_array_policy: Arrays length < 8 remain Generic to avoid buffer churn; homogeneous arrays >= 8 promote to FlatBuffer

field_ic_contracts.architecture: Mono IC -> Poly IC (up to 4 shapes) -> Megamorphic Fallback
field_ic_contracts.invalidation: Triggered on shape mutations or class field additions
